verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official MCP server documented at attio.com/mcp. First-party docs say users can connect Claude, ChatGPT or another AI tool to search, update and manage their Attio workspace, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: detailed setup/auth documentation (e.g. OAuth flow, endpoint URL), a list of exposed tools and permission scoping, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.
